entities.summary: The Madras High Court is an Indian high court that has appellate jurisdiction over the state of Tamil Nadu and the union territory of Puducherry. It also exercises original jurisdiction over the city of Chennai, also known as Madras, and for the issue of writs under the Constitution of India. It is located in Chennai, with an additional bench at Madurai.
